title: Assistants.
bodyText: The director may appoint and remove assistants to assist the director in carrying out the director's activities, duties, and other obligations under this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§440E-2]  Assistants.  The director may appoint and remove assistants to assist the director in carrying out the director's activities, duties, and other obligations under this chapter. [L 2007, c 279, pt of §1]
